records.jp: 日菜子さんはバレエ以外の色んなことに興味を持とうとしているみたい。その心意気やよし！　一緒に新しいものを知っていこう！
records.en_original: Hinako is trying to take an interest in things other than ballet. Good for her! I should help her find new things she likes!
records.en: Hinako is trying to take an interest in things other than ballet. Good for her! I should help her find new things she likes!

records.jp: 意外にも球技が苦手だという日菜子さんだけど、実際にやってみるとすぐに上達した。また違う球技にも誘ってみよう
records.en_original: Hinako said she wasn't very good at ball sports, but she improved surprisingly quickly when she actually tried it. I should ask her to play again sometime.
records.en: Hinako said she wasn't very good at ball sports, but she improved surprisingly quickly when she actually tried it. I should ask her to play again sometime.

records.jp: 日菜子さんは寒いのが苦手で、お風呂が好きみたい。この世界が突然冬に変わったら日菜子さんは特に苦労しそうだ……
records.en_original: Hinako hates the cold and loves baths. If winter suddenly came to this world, Hinako would have a pretty hard time...
records.en: Hinako hates the cold and loves baths. If winter suddenly came to this world, Hinako would have a pretty hard time...

records.jp: 何でもそつなくこなすイメージだったけど、実は筋金入りの不器用だった日菜子さん。でもそういう所も可愛い！好き！
records.en_original: Hinako seems like the kind of girl who can do anything, but it turns out she's all thumbs. That just makes her even cuter, though! I like her!
records.en: Hinako seems like the kind of girl who can do anything, but it turns out she's all thumbs. That just makes her even cuter, though! I like her!

records.jp: 休日はぼーっと過ごすことが多いという日菜子さん。でもストレッチの習慣は続いているみたいだし、他にも新しい趣味が見つかるといいな
records.en_original: Hinako says that she usually spends her days off lazing around, but apparently she's been doing stretches every day for years. I hope she's able to find some new hobbies too.
records.en: Hinako says that she usually spends her days off lazing around, but apparently she's been doing stretches every day for years. I hope she's able to find some new hobbies too.

records.jp: 大事にしたいと思うものがたくさんできたことで、挫折から立ち直ることができた日菜子さん。私も支えてくれているみんなをちゃんと支えられるよう頑張ろう！
records.en_original: Hinako was able to move past her hardships because she met people who she wanted to protect. I'll try harder to support everyone who's supporting me too!
records.en: Hinako was able to move past her hardships because she met people who she wanted to protect. I'll try harder to support everyone who's supporting me too!

records.jp: 一緒にアサガオを眺めながら、日菜子さんの独特な感性を感じた。アサガオといえば浴衣。浴衣姿の日菜子さん、見てみたいなー
records.en_original: Looking at the morning glories together, I really felt Hinako's unique sensibilities. Morning glories remind me of yukata. I'd love to see Hinako in a yukata someday...
records.en: Looking at the morning glories together, I really felt Hinako's unique sensibilities. Morning glories remind me of yukata. I'd love to see Hinako in a yukata someday...

records.jp: 自販機の「つめた～い」をそのまま読んだり、時々抜けている一面を見せる日菜子さん。でもそれも日菜子さんの魅力だよね
records.en_original: Hinako sometimes shows a side of herself that's a little off, like when she asked for a "coolicious" drink. But I kinda like that about her.
records.en: Hinako sometimes shows a side of herself that's a little off, like when she asked for a "coolicious" drink. But I kinda like that about her.

records.jp: バレエの為に切り捨ててきたことをつい考えてしまうという日菜子さん。けどバレエのお陰でできたいい思い出だってたくさんあるはず。前向きに捉えることができるようになったらいいな
records.en_original: Hinako said she thinks a lot about what she had to give up because of ballet. But I'm sure ballet gave her lots of good memories too. I hope she can learn to look on the bright side.
records.en: Hinako said she thinks a lot about what she had to give up because of ballet. But I'm sure ballet gave her lots of good memories too. I hope she can learn to look on the bright side.

records.jp: カフェでの理想の過ごし方について日菜子さんと話した。日菜子さんと一緒ならどんな過ごし方でも楽しめそう
records.en_original: Hinako and I talked about the ideal way to spend time at a cafe. I think I'd enjoy doing anything as long as it was with Hinako.
records.en: Hinako and I talked about the ideal way to spend time at a cafe. I think I'd enjoy doing anything as long as it was with Hinako.

records.jp: 日菜子さんと映画を見て過ごした。私の好きな^00「劇場版　屍神の法則」も楽しんでくれたみたい。次は原作を布教しよう
records.en_original: Hinako and I watched some movies together. She seemed to like my favorite movie, The Death God Theory. Next I have to tell her all about the original manga.
records.en: Hinako and I watched some movies together. She seemed to like my favorite movie, The Death God Theory. Next I have to tell her all about the original manga.

records.jp: 二人でぬいぐるみの包容力を全力で堪能した。日菜子さんは頑張りすぎるところがあるから、定期的に連れてくるようにしよう
records.en_original: We both really enjoyed hugging the soft, fluffy plushie. Hinako tends to push herself too hard, so I'll have to bring her back here from time to time to unwind.
records.en: We both really enjoyed hugging the soft, fluffy plushie. Hinako tends to push herself too hard, so I'll have to bring her back here from time to time to unwind.

records.jp: 日菜子さんと電気が使えなくなった時のことを想像したけど、私は到底生きていけそうにない。生活に必要な施設をもっと増やしていこう
records.en_original: Hinako and I imagined what it would be like if we lost access to electricity. I don't think I could survive. We should build more facilities we need for daily life.
records.en: Hinako and I imagined what it would be like if we lost access to electricity. I don't think I could survive. We should build more facilities we need for daily life.

records.jp: 一人暮らしに憧れがあるという日菜子さんと、理想の部屋について話した。いつか自分の「好き」が詰まった部屋に住めたらいいな
records.en_original: Hinako has always dreamed of living alone, so she told me all about her ideal apartment. I hope I can live in a place filled with stuff I like someday.
records.en: Hinako has always dreamed of living alone, so she told me all about her ideal apartment. I hope I can live in a place filled with stuff I like someday.

records.jp: 水着姿の日菜子さんのスタイルに惚れ惚れした。そんな日菜子さんが私に気を許してくれていると知り、嬉しくなった
records.en_original: I got to see Hinako in a swimsuit! I might have gotten a bit too excited, but she didn't seem to mind. Good to know that she's comfortable around me.
records.en: I got to see Hinako in a swimsuit! I might have gotten a bit too excited, but she didn't seem to mind. Good to know that she's comfortable around me.

records.jp: 普段からオシャレなこころはファッション雑誌をよく読むみたい。私も見習ってオシャレの勉強を始めよう！
records.en_original: The ever-fashionable Kokoro seems to read a lot of fashion magazines. I should follow her example and start studying fashion!
records.en: The ever-fashionable Kokoro seems to read a lot of fashion magazines. I should follow her example and start studying fashion!

records.jp: 田舎で育ったこころは、小さい頃は近くの川でパンツ^00いっちょで水遊び、なんてこともあったみたい。^00羨まし……じゃなくて、意外な一面を知れて良かった
records.en_original: Growing up in the country, Kokoro used to play in a nearby river in her underwear when she was little. I'm totally not jealous...I'm just glad I got to see a side of her I wouldn't have expected.
records.en: Growing up in the country, Kokoro used to play in a nearby river in her underwear when she was little. I'm totally not jealous...I'm just glad I got to see a side of her I wouldn't have expected.

records.jp: こころの学校では、学校や地域の人が育てた食材を使って調理実習をしてたみたい。食欲や料理上手は、育った地域が理由かも
records.en_original: Apparently at Kokoro's school, they learned to cook using ingredients from the local community. Her love of food and cooking skills might have to do with where she grew up.
records.en: Apparently at Kokoro's school, they learned to cook using ingredients from the local community. Her love of food and cooking skills might have to do with where she grew up.

records.jp: こころと体育館で体を動かして過ごした。こころの運動神経の良さは、一時期習っていた空手が影響しているみたい
records.en_original: Kokoro and I spent some time working out at the gym. She's pretty athletic, probably because she used to do karate.
records.en: Kokoro and I spent some time working out at the gym. She's pretty athletic, probably because she used to do karate.

records.jp: この世界に来てすぐの頃、屋上で考え事していたことはこころにバレていた。でもみんながいるから、もうあの時みたいな不安はない
records.en_original: Kokoro found out that I would come up to the rooftop to think when I first came to this world. But now that everyone is here, I don't feel anxious like I did back then.
records.en: Kokoro found out that I would come up to the rooftop to think when I first came to this world. But now that everyone is here, I don't feel anxious like I did back then.

records.jp: 授業中に居眠りしちゃって、気づいたら放課後なんてこともあったというこころ。こころらしいけど、周りの人はなんで起こさなかったのだろう……？
records.en_original: Kokoro used to fall asleep in class, and by the time she woke up, school had already finished. That sounds like Kokoro, but I wonder why no one bothered to wake her up...?
records.en: Kokoro used to fall asleep in class, and by the time she woke up, school had already finished. That sounds like Kokoro, but I wonder why no one bothered to wake her up...?

records.jp: こころは学校に毎日手作りのお弁当を用意していたらしい。好きなものを入れられるのは魅力的だけど、私は長続きしなさそう……
records.en_original: Apparently Kokoro used to pack her own lunch before school every day. It'd be nice to be able to pack whatever you want, but I don't think I'd be able to do it every day...
records.en: Apparently Kokoro used to pack her own lunch before school every day. It'd be nice to be able to pack whatever you want, but I don't think I'd be able to do it every day...

records.jp: こころにたこ焼きの作り方を伝授してもらった。今回は殆ど任せっきりだったから、次は私がこころに作ってあげよう！
records.en_original: I asked Kokoro to teach me how to make takoyaki. She did most of the work this time, so I'll make them for her next time!
records.en: I asked Kokoro to teach me how to make takoyaki. She did most of the work this time, so I'll make them for her next time!

records.jp: こころとシンボルツリーの下でくつろいだ。それにしてもこころが自然の中で休む姿、すごく似合うなぁ
records.en_original: Kokoro and I chilled under the shady tree. She seemed right at home relaxing in nature.
records.en: Kokoro and I chilled under the shady tree. She seemed right at home relaxing in nature.

records.jp: 海の家のメニューについてこころと話した。あの海の家ならではの特別な魅力……。思い出すだけでお腹が空いてきた……
records.en_original: Kokoro and I talked about the menu at the beachside cafe. That place has a special charm to it. I'm getting hungry just thinking about it...
records.en: Kokoro and I talked about the menu at the beachside cafe. That place has a special charm to it. I'm getting hungry just thinking about it...

records.jp: お米作りに対して並々ならぬやる気を見せるこころ。たんぼは慣れないし手作業は大変だけど、豊かな食生活とこころの笑顔のために頑張ろう！
records.en_original: Kokoro was really enthusiastic about growing rice. I'm not used to doing hard work in a field, but getting to eat delicious food and see Kokoro's smile makes it all worth it!
records.en: Kokoro was really enthusiastic about growing rice. I'm not used to doing hard work in a field, but getting to eat delicious food and see Kokoro's smile makes it all worth it!

records.jp: こころと甘い食べ物の魅力を語った。食べ物が大好きなこころと一緒に何か食べたり、作ったりするのはとっても楽しいし、幸せな気分になれる
records.en_original: Kokoro and I talked about our favorite sweets. Kokoro loves food, so eating or making food with her is so much fun. It never fails to put me in a good mood.
records.en: Kokoro and I talked about our favorite sweets. Kokoro loves food, so eating or making food with her is so much fun. It never fails to put me in a good mood.

records.jp: 屋台の射的のコツをこころに教えてもらった。距離が近くてドキドキしたけど、指導の後すぐに当てられるようになった
records.en_original: Kokoro taught me how to shoot at the shooting gallery. I was pretty nervous because she got so close to me, but I was able to hit the target right away after she showed me.
records.en: Kokoro taught me how to shoot at the shooting gallery. I was pretty nervous because she got so close to me, but I was able to hit the target right away after she showed me.

records.jp: 肝試しでもなんでみんなが怖がっているか分からないという程肝が据わっているこころ。灯籠の影に何か見え^00たって言ってたけど、気のせい……だよね……？
records.en_original: Kokoro is so brave that she doesn't understand why people get scared of ghost stories. She said she saw something behind a lantern, but she was messing with me...right...?
records.en: Kokoro is so brave that she doesn't understand why people get scared of ghost stories. She said she saw something behind a lantern, but she was messing with me...right...?

records.jp: 小さい頃お父さんに連れられて、よくキャンプをしていたというこころ。イノシシを猟銃で仕留めて食材にしたり、かなりワイルドなキャンプだったみたい
records.en_original: Kokoro said she used to go camping with her father. Apparently he used to hunt wild boar with a rifle and then cook them up. Sounds pretty wild!
records.en: Kokoro said she used to go camping with her father. Apparently he used to hunt wild boar with a rifle and then cook them up. Sounds pretty wild!

records.jp: 伶那さんと一緒にストレッチをした。苦戦する私を見てすぐにアドバイスをくれたり、伶那さんの隠し切れない優しさや気遣いを感じた
records.en_original: I did some stretches with Rena. She gave me advice as soon as she saw me struggling. She wasn't able to completely hide her kindness and concern this time.
records.en: I did some stretches with Rena. She gave me advice as soon as she saw me struggling. She wasn't able to completely hide her kindness and concern this time.

records.jp: 伶那さんにおススメのラノベを紹介した。借りていってくれたみたいだし、気に入ってくれた……のかな？
records.en_original: I recommended a YA novel to Rena. She seems to be checking it out, so I think she's enjoying it...maybe?
records.en: I recommended a YA novel to Rena. She seems to be checking it out, so I think she's enjoying it...maybe?

records.jp: 屋上部室を物色している伶那さんは今まで見たことがない程イキイキしていた。道具には興味を持てないけど、伶那さんが作るロボットは気になるなぁー
records.en_original: I've never seen Rena look more alive than when she was rummaging through the rooftop storage room. I'm not interested in tools, but I am curious about the robots she makes.
records.en: I've never seen Rena look more alive than when she was rummaging through the rooftop storage room. I'm not interested in tools, but I am curious about the robots she makes.

records.jp: 放送室で伶那さんに音楽のかけ方を教えた。意外と興味を持ってそうだったし、また今度おススメの曲を教えてもらおう
records.en_original: I showed Rena how to play music in the broadcasting room. She seemed surprisingly into it. I'll have to ask her to recommend some songs next time.
records.en: I showed Rena how to play music in the broadcasting room. She seemed surprisingly into it. I'll have to ask her to recommend some songs next time.

records.jp: 少しふらついている私を見て、伶那さんが診察してくれた。素直じゃないけど、とても優しくて素敵な人だ
records.en_original: Rena saw that I was a little dizzy, so she gave me a checkup. Her bedside manner may not be the best, but she's a really kind and loving person.
records.en: Rena saw that I was a little dizzy, so she gave me a checkup. Her bedside manner may not be the best, but she's a really kind and loving person.

records.jp: 伶那さんが普段見せないような緩い一面を見せてくれた。私に心を開いてくれているのを感じて、何だか嬉しかった
records.en_original: Rena showed me a gentler side of herself that she doesn't normally let people see. I'm really happy that she seems to be opening up to me.
records.en: Rena showed me a gentler side of herself that she doesn't normally let people see. I'm really happy that she seems to be opening up to me.

records.jp: 伶那さんと一緒に勉強したら、分からないところをめ^00ちゃくちゃ丁寧に教えてくれた。勉強は苦手だけど、伶那さんが先生だったら頑張れそう！
records.en_original: When I studied with Rena, she explained the things I didn't understand in a very clear and understanding way. I'm not a very good student, but if Rena were my teacher I would study hard!
records.en: When I studied with Rena, she explained the things I didn't understand in a very clear and understanding way. I'm not a very good student, but if Rena were my teacher I would study hard!

records.jp: 研究熱心な伶那さんとアサガオの観察をした。種は薬にも毒にもなるらしい。「毒」ってワード、厨二心がくすぐられる……！
records.en_original: Rena sure loves to do research. We studied the morning glories—apparently the seeds have both medicinal and toxic properties. The word "toxic" sounds so edgy...!
records.en: Rena sure loves to do research. We studied the morning glories—apparently the seeds have both medicinal and toxic properties. The word "toxic" sounds so edgy...!

records.jp: 伶那さんは最近絵を描く練習を始めたらしい。みんなに見られたくないみたいだけど、上手いし堂々と描けばいいのになぁー
records.en_original: Rena has recently taken up drawing. She doesn't want people to see her work, but they're really good. I think she should display them proudly!
records.en: Rena has recently taken up drawing. She doesn't want people to see her work, but they're really good. I think she should display them proudly!

records.jp: 狭いテントで近づくと照れちゃう伶那さん……^00可愛い……！！　また違う所で伶那さんとテントでお泊りしたいなー
records.en_original: Rena was all embarrassed when I got close to her in that tiny tent. It was so cute! I'd love to spend the night with her in a tent somewhere else.
records.en: Rena was all embarrassed when I got close to her in that tiny tent. It was so cute! I'd love to spend the night with her in a tent somewhere else.

records.jp: 伶那さんとプール風呂のより良い使い方について話した。せっかく自由に使えるんだし、みんなが楽しめる場所に改良していきたいな
records.en_original: Rena and I talked about how we could upgrade the bath. Since it's ours to use whenever we want, it'd be nice to make it a place that all of us can enjoy.
records.en: Rena and I talked about how we could upgrade the bath. Since it's ours to use whenever we want, it'd be nice to make it a place that all of us can enjoy.

records.jp: 伶那さんと即売会のシミュレーションをした。ガチガチだったけど、緊張はそれだけ真剣な証。お客さんにも^00きっと熱意が伝わると思うな
records.en_original: I helped Rena role-play selling her comics at a comic convention. She was super nervous, but that just shows that she's serious about it. I'm sure her customers will feel her enthusiasm.
records.en: I helped Rena role-play selling her comics at a comic convention. She was super nervous, but that just shows that she's serious about it. I'm sure her customers will feel her enthusiasm.

records.jp: 怖がる伶那さんが可愛くて、ついいじわるしちゃった。それにしても、井戸を不気味に感じるのって何でなんだろう？
records.en_original: I felt bad for teasing her, but Rena is just so cute when she's scared. What is it about wells that makes them so scary, anyway?
records.en: I felt bad for teasing her, but Rena is just so cute when she's scared. What is it about wells that makes them so scary, anyway?

records.jp: 勇希の好きな曲を練習して弾けるようになった伶那さん。一途で素敵だし、勇希は幸せ者だ
records.en_original: Rena practiced until she was able to play Yuki's favorite song. She's so dedicated and sweet! Yuki is a very lucky lady.
records.en: Rena practiced until she was able to play Yuki's favorite song. She's so dedicated and sweet! Yuki is a very lucky lady.

records.jp: 伶那さんの話してくれる知識は、正直難しい時もあるけど、面白くて役に立つし、何より私にだけ話してくれる特別感が嬉しい
records.en_original: To be honest, the knowledge Rena shares with me can be difficult to understand, but it's always interesting and useful. Plus, I feel special because I'm the only one she shares it with.
records.en: To be honest, the knowledge Rena shares with me can be difficult to understand, but it's always interesting and useful. Plus, I feel special because I'm the only one she shares it with.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと放送室で絵本の読み聞かせをした。姉妹の思い出のお話だったみたいだし、美弦さんもきっと喜んでくれたよね
records.en_original: Hiori and I did a live reading of a children's book from the Broadcasting Room. Sounds like the story means a lot to Hiori and her sister. I hope Mio enjoyed it too.
records.en: Hiori and I did a live reading of a children's book from the Broadcasting Room. Sounds like the story means a lot to Hiori and her sister. I hope Mio enjoyed it too.

records.jp: 美弦さんが自分のために色々我慢してきたことを気にしている陽桜莉さん。でも二人なら、これからいくらでも楽しい思い出を作れると思う
records.en_original: Hiori feels bad about everything Mio had to give up to take care of her. But I'm sure they'll have plenty of happy times going forward.
records.en: Hiori feels bad about everything Mio had to give up to take care of her. But I'm sure they'll have plenty of happy times going forward.

records.jp: 綺麗な石を使って陽桜莉さんとハンドメイドの工作をした。陽桜莉さんの作ったものは、いかにも^00「陽桜莉さん」って感じで、とても素敵な作品だった
records.en_original: Hiori and I made some crafts using pretty stones. Hers was beautiful—classic Hiori.
records.en: Hiori and I made some crafts using pretty stones. Hers was beautiful—classic Hiori.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと教室で「特別」探しをした。気づいてないだけで、色んなところに特別はあるのかもしれない。^00……照れて真っ赤になった陽桜莉さんの顔は間違いなく特別だった
records.en_original: Hiori and I looked for something special in the classroom. We may not notice, but there are special things all around us. Like that look on Hiori's face when she got embarrassed.
records.en: Hiori and I looked for something special in the classroom. We may not notice, but there are special things all around us. Like that look on Hiori's face when she got embarrassed.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと一緒にカレーを作った。二人で何かをするのはすごい楽しいし、また何か誘ってみよう
records.en_original: I made curry with Hiori today. I always have a really good time with her. I should invite her to do something together again.
records.en: I made curry with Hiori today. I always have a really good time with her. I should invite her to do something together again.

records.jp: プールで溺れたふりをして、陽桜莉さんを本気で心配させちゃった。いつも気に掛けてくれているのに騙すなんて良くなかったな。ちゃんと反省しよう
records.en_original: I accidently freaked out Hiori by pretending to drown in the pool. I feel terrible for pranking her like that when I know she's always watching out for me. I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.
records.en: I accidently freaked out Hiori by pretending to drown in the pool. I feel terrible for pranking her like that when I know she's always watching out for me. I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと制服のまま水浴びをした。水着じゃないのはお互いの失敗がきっかけだったけど、普段と全然違う感じで楽しかった！
records.en_original: Hiori and I got our clothes all wet today. We probably should have just worn our swimsuits, but we still had a lot of fun.
records.en: Hiori and I got our clothes all wet today. We probably should have just worn our swimsuits, but we still had a lot of fun.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんに「愛央ちゃんみたいな妹が欲しい」って^00言ってもらえて、嬉しくて照れちゃった。陽桜莉さんと美弦さんみたいに、姉妹の絆ってやっぱり特別に感じるなぁー
records.en_original: I was so happy to hear Hiori say that she wished she had a little sister like me! Seeing Hiori and Mio makes me think that a sisterly bond really is a special thing.
records.en: I was so happy to hear Hiori say that she wished she had a little sister like me! Seeing Hiori and Mio makes me think that a sisterly bond really is a special thing.

records.jp: 未来のことを考えて気落ちしてたら、陽桜莉さんが励ましてくれた。おかげで明日からも前を向いて頑張れそう。……ありがとう、陽桜莉さん
records.en_original: I was feeling down thinking about the future, but Hiori came by to cheer me up. I feel like I can be a bit more optimistic now. Thanks, Hiori.
records.en: I was feeling down thinking about the future, but Hiori came by to cheer me up. I feel like I can be a bit more optimistic now. Thanks, Hiori.

records.jp: 七夕は陽桜莉さんにとって色んな思い出がつまった特別な日みたい。これまで頑張った分、これから陽桜莉さんに色んな幸せが訪れますように！
records.en_original: Tanabata means a lot to Hiori. She's done so much for us, so my wish this year is that Hiori be blessed with happiness!
records.en: Tanabata means a lot to Hiori. She's done so much for us, so my wish this year is that Hiori be blessed with happiness!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは雫世界にいたら好きなものばかり食べて太ることを心配しているみたい。今も細いぐらいだし、戦いで動くから大丈夫だと思うけどなー
records.en_original: Hiori is worried that she'll gain weight while she's in Oasis since she can eat anything she wants. She looks pretty skinny to me. She moves around so much while fighting, I think she'll be fine.
records.en: Hiori is worried that she'll gain weight while she's in Oasis since she can eat anything she wants. She looks pretty skinny to me. She moves around so much while fighting, I think she'll be fine.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんはお母さんがいなくなった時から、明かりを絶やすことに不安を感じるみたい。私やみんなの存在で、少しでも不安が和らげばいいな
records.en_original: Hiori said the dark makes her nervous ever since her mom left. I hope our presence here can help her feel a bit more at ease.
records.en: Hiori said the dark makes her nervous ever since her mom left. I hope our presence here can help her feel a bit more at ease.

records.jp: 元の世界に戻りたい気持ちと同じくらい、みんなと一緒にいたいという陽桜莉さん。この先何があっても後悔しないよう、みんなとの時間や絆を大切にしよう
records.en_original: Hiori told me that, while she wants to go home just like everyone else, being with everyone is important to her. I want to enjoy the time I have with everyone too. No regrets.
records.en: Hiori told me that, while she wants to go home just like everyone else, being with everyone is important to her. I want to enjoy the time I have with everyone too. No regrets.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんと話してて気が付いたけど、今の状況って、まさにサバイバルだよね……。みんながいるしすっかり慣れてたけど、いつか元の世界に戻れるよう、頑張らなくちゃ！
records.en_original: Talking with Hiori reminded me that our life here is about survival. We may have all gotten used to living in Oasis, but we have to keep our eyes on the prize: getting back home!
records.en: Talking with Hiori reminded me that our life here is about survival. We may have all gotten used to living in Oasis, but we have to keep our eyes on the prize: getting back home!

records.jp: ひまわりで花占いをしようとして、途中で諦めてしまった陽桜莉さん。占いに頼らなくても、みんな陽桜莉さんが好きだと思うな
records.en_original: Hiori was playing "she loves me, she loves me not" with a sunflower, but stopped halfway through. I hope she knows just how much everyone loves her.
records.en: Hiori was playing "she loves me, she loves me not" with a sunflower, but stopped halfway through. I hope she knows just how much everyone loves her.

records.jp: 詩帆さんが私たちの教室の空気に染まってしまうとこ^00だった……。まぁ頑張りすぎちゃうタイプだし、たまには休んでもらわないとね
records.en_original: Shiho fell asleep in our classroom—I guess we were a bad influence on her. But she's always working so hard, so I'm glad she got to take a break.
records.en: Shiho fell asleep in our classroom—I guess we were a bad influence on her. But she's always working so hard, so I'm glad she got to take a break.

records.jp: 詩帆さんはこの世界に対する前向きな気持ちに後ろめたさを感じてたみたい。でもこんな状況だからこそ自分に正直に楽しまないとね！
records.en_original: Shiho seemed to feel guilty about having a positive attitude toward this world. But this is the exact kind of situation where you have to be honest with yourself and have fun!
records.en: Shiho seemed to feel guilty about having a positive attitude toward this world. But this is the exact kind of situation where you have to be honest with yourself and have fun!

records.jp: 家事に対する熱意が凄い詩帆さん。お陰で毎日美味しいものを食べられてるし、家事以外のことは私が詩帆さんの手助けをしよう
records.en_original: Shiho is incredibly enthusiastic about housework. Thanks to her, I get to eat delicious food every day. I'll have to find something I can do for her—other than help out with chores.
records.en: Shiho is incredibly enthusiastic about housework. Thanks to her, I get to eat delicious food every day. I'll have to find something I can do for her—other than help out with chores.

records.jp: 詩帆さんが２階教室でもてなしてくれた。優しいし、面倒見いいし、世話好きだし……。詩帆さんは素敵なお嫁さんになりそう
records.en_original: Shiho treated me to her homemade coffee in the 2F classroom. She's kind, caring, and attentive... She'll make a wonderful wife someday.
records.en: Shiho treated me to her homemade coffee in the 2F classroom. She's kind, caring, and attentive... She'll make a wonderful wife someday.

records.jp: 詩帆さんに恋愛ものの小説をおススメしたら、狙い通りハマってくれたみたい。また今度違うジャンルの本も紹介してみよう
records.en_original: I recommended a romance novel to Shiho, and just as I'd hoped, she got completely hooked. Maybe I'll try introducing her to a different genre of books next time.
records.en: I recommended a romance novel to Shiho, and just as I'd hoped, she got completely hooked. Maybe I'll try introducing her to a different genre of books next time.

records.jp: 元演劇部の詩帆さんが、学祭のシミュレーションでアイドルっぽい挨拶を披露してくれた。アイドル姿の詩帆さん、間違いなく似合う……
records.en_original: It turns out that Shiho used to be in the drama club. We put on an imaginary school festival and she made a perfect emcee! Shiho is definitely cut out to be a star...
records.en: It turns out that Shiho used to be in the drama club. We put on an imaginary school festival and she made a perfect emcee! Shiho is definitely cut out to be a star...

records.jp: 料理のことを考えている詩帆さんはいつも楽しそう。アイデアもどんどん出てくるし、本当に料理のことが好きなんだな
records.en_original: Shiho always looks happy when she's thinking about cooking. She must really love to cook—she's so full of ideas!
records.en: Shiho always looks happy when she's thinking about cooking. She must really love to cook—she's so full of ideas!

records.jp: 海の家で詩帆さんに焼きそばとかき氷を作ってもらった。両方美味しかったし、詩帆さんをからかったら可愛い反応も見れたし、大満足
records.en_original: Shiho made me yakisoba and shaved ice at the beachside cafe. They were both delicious, of course. I also teased her a bit and her reaction was adorable! Best day ever.
records.en: Shiho made me yakisoba and shaved ice at the beachside cafe. They were both delicious, of course. I also teased her a bit and her reaction was adorable! Best day ever.

records.jp: 詩帆さんと駅のホームでゆっくり過ごした。この駅はどこにも繋がってないけど、元の世界に戻れたらみんなで色んな所を旅してみたいな
records.en_original: Shiho and I spent some time on the train platform. The train never comes here, but if we ever get back to our world, I'd love to go on a trip with everyone.
records.en: Shiho and I spent some time on the train platform. The train never comes here, but if we ever get back to our world, I'd love to go on a trip with everyone.

records.jp: 詩帆さんの料理スキルは、料理に対する情熱と、沢山の試行錯誤の結果身についたものだった。今度作ってもらうものを考えるだけでワクワクする！
records.en_original: Shiho's cooking skills are the result of a passion for cooking and lots of trial and error. I can't wait to see what she cooks up next!
records.en: Shiho's cooking skills are the result of a passion for cooking and lots of trial and error. I can't wait to see what she cooks up next!

records.jp: 詩帆さんとキングサイズのベッドでひと眠りした。いつも頑張ってくれてるし、こうやってのんびり過ごす時間も大事だよね
records.en_original: Shiho and I took a nap on the king-size bed. She always works so hard, so it's important for her to spend some time relaxing like this.
records.en: Shiho and I took a nap on the king-size bed. She always works so hard, so it's important for her to spend some time relaxing like this.

records.jp: 詩帆さんと一緒に商店街のゲートの上から周りを見下ろした。ゲートからは私たちがこんな風に見えてたんだ^00なぁ
records.en_original: Shiho and I took in the view from the top of the shopping street sign. It was fun looking down at everything from the sign's perspective.
records.en: Shiho and I took in the view from the top of the shopping street sign. It was fun looking down at everything from the sign's perspective.

records.jp: 射的で的に当てることに執念を燃やす詩帆さん。薄々感じてたけど、詩帆さんって実はかなりの負けず嫌い……？
records.en_original: Shiho got a bit carried away at the shooting gallery. I'd had a hunch, but I think Shiho is actually really competitive!
records.en: Shiho got a bit carried away at the shooting gallery. I'd had a hunch, but I think Shiho is actually really competitive!

records.jp: 詩帆さんと制服のままシャワーを浴びた。冷たくてすっきりしたし、詩帆さんからめっちゃいい匂いがした
records.en_original: Shiho and I took a shower in our uniforms. The cold water was nice and refreshing, and Shiho smelled really good.
records.en: Shiho and I took a shower in our uniforms. The cold water was nice and refreshing, and Shiho smelled really good.

records.jp: 詩帆さんとたんぼでしっかり実った穂を観察した。お米の使い方も色々考えているみたいだし、今から収穫が楽しみ！
records.en_original: Shiho and I visited the rice paddy to see how the rice is growing. She's already thought of all kinds of different ways to use the rice. I'm looking forward to the harvest!
records.en: Shiho and I visited the rice paddy to see how the rice is growing. She's already thought of all kinds of different ways to use the rice. I'm looking forward to the harvest!

records.jp: 勇希は想像以上に勉強が苦手だった。けど素直で一生懸命だし、教え甲斐があって楽しかった。また暫くしたら勉強にも誘ってみよう
records.en_original: Yuki's worse at studying than I thought. Even so, she's honest and hardworking, so it's fun to teach her. I should see if she wants to study again sometime.
records.en: Yuki's worse at studying than I thought. Even so, she's honest and hardworking, so it's fun to teach her. I should see if she wants to study again sometime.

records.jp: 何でも全力で楽しむ勇希と一緒に遊ぶと、つられて私も楽しくなる。でも全力過ぎてちょっと心配……。危な^00かったらちゃんと止めてあげよう
records.en_original: Yuki always enjoys everything to the max. She's super fun to hang out with, but I actually get a little worried sometimes... I'll have to stop her if it ever gets out of hand.
records.en: Yuki always enjoys everything to the max. She's super fun to hang out with, but I actually get a little worried sometimes... I'll have to stop her if it ever gets out of hand.

records.jp: 図書室で勇希が少女漫画をおススメしてくれた。それも結構乙女なタイプ。ちょっと意外だったけど、こういう日常に憧れる気持ち、分かるなー
records.en_original: Yuki recommended a high school manga to me at the library—a pretty girly one at that. It was a bit unexpected, but I understand why Yuki would admire that kind of life.
records.en: Yuki recommended a high school manga to me at the library—a pretty girly one at that. It was a bit unexpected, but I understand why Yuki would admire that kind of life.

records.jp: 勇希と今度ラジオに挑戦することになった。勇希が言ってた「最近あった嬉しいこと」ってテーマ、ベタだけどみんなの嬉しかったことを聞くと確かに元気になれそう
records.en_original: Yuki and I decided to start a radio show. Yuki's idea for a segment asking everyone what made them happy recently is a little cheesy, but hearing their stories will definitely put a smile on my face.
records.en: Yuki and I decided to start a radio show. Yuki's idea for a segment asking everyone what made them happy recently is a little cheesy, but hearing their stories will definitely put a smile on my face.

records.jp: 勇希は、病院の記憶から嫌いになっていたベッドを、いつの間にか克服していた。きっと私たちとの思い出が、嫌な記憶を上書きしてくれたおかげだよね
records.en_original: Yuki seems to have gotten over her dislike of beds that she got from being hospitalized all that time. I'm sure the happy memories we've made together have overwritten all her bad ones.
records.en: Yuki seems to have gotten over her dislike of beds that she got from being hospitalized all that time. I'm sure the happy memories we've made together have overwritten all her bad ones.

records.jp: 勇希はこの世界での暮らしを夏休みに例えた。寂しいけど、そろそろやり残した「宿題」を片づけてこのかけがえのない夏休みを終わらせよう
records.en_original: Yuki compared our life in this world to summer vacation. It makes me sad, but I guess it's time to finish my "assignments" and bring this once-in-a-lifetime summer vacation to an end.
records.en: Yuki compared our life in this world to summer vacation. It makes me sad, but I guess it's time to finish my "assignments" and bring this once-in-a-lifetime summer vacation to an end.

records.jp: ビーチパラソルの下で勇希とバカンス気分を満喫した。すぐちょっかいをかけてくるし何かと忙しないけど、勇希と遊ぶのは楽しいし、元気をもらえる
records.en_original: Yuki and I soaked in some vacation vibes under a beach parasol. She's got boundless energy and is always messing with me, but it makes hanging out with her fun and energizing.
records.en: Yuki and I soaked in some vacation vibes under a beach parasol. She's got boundless energy and is always messing with me, but it makes hanging out with her fun and energizing.

records.jp: 目当てのものが出るまでカプセルトイを回し続けた勇希。こんなところも勇希らしいけど、本人はちょっとやり過ぎたと反省してるみたい
records.en_original: Yuki put way too much money into a capsule machine trying to get the toy she wanted. Even she seemed to realize that she went a little overboard.
records.en: Yuki put way too much money into a capsule machine trying to get the toy she wanted. Even she seemed to realize that she went a little overboard.

records.jp: 勇希と畳部屋でくつろいだ。普段勇希とははしゃいで^00ばっかりだけど、たまにはああやってのんびりするのも良いな
records.en_original: Yuki and I relaxed in the room with tatami mats. We usually run around all over the place when we hang out, but it's nice to take it easy like that every now and then.
records.en: Yuki and I relaxed in the room with tatami mats. We usually run around all over the place when we hang out, but it's nice to take it easy like that every now and then.

records.jp: 勇希は星を見るのが好きみたいで、実際に凄く詳しかった。普段何気なく見る夜空も、あれだけ詳しいと私とは全く違って見えるんだろうな
records.en_original: Yuki seems to like stargazing, and she actually knows a lot about the stars. The night sky must look completely different to someone who knows so much about it.
records.en: Yuki seems to like stargazing, and she actually knows a lot about the stars. The night sky must look completely different to someone who knows so much about it.

records.jp: 目立ちたがりな勇希は、ステージに立ってるとキラキラして見えた。可愛くて元気いっぱいだし、アイドルは勇希の天職かもしれない
records.en_original: Yuki really shines when she stands onstage. She's so cute and full of energy! Being a pop star might be her true calling.
records.en: Yuki really shines when she stands onstage. She's so cute and full of energy! Being a pop star might be her true calling.

records.jp: 勇希はみんなの力になれていないと悩んでいるみたい。でも、いつも明るくて元気な勇希にみんな元気をもらっている。それだけで立派なみんなを支える力だ
records.en_original: Yuki seems worried that she isn't able to help everyone. She doesn't realize that she lifts us all up with her cheerful and energetic spirit.
records.en: Yuki seems worried that she isn't able to help everyone. She doesn't realize that she lifts us all up with her cheerful and energetic spirit.

records.jp: 屋台のりんご飴を食べながら、勇希とお祭り気分を楽しんだ。勇希の何でも楽しむ姿勢は素敵だし、憧れる
records.en_original: Yuki and I had candy apples from a food stall, which made us feel like we were at a festival. I really admire how she's always able to enjoy everything to the fullest.
records.en: Yuki and I had candy apples from a food stall, which made us feel like we were at a festival. I really admire how she's always able to enjoy everything to the fullest.

records.jp: 金魚すくいに苦戦する勇希にコツを伝授した。真剣な勇希を見ていると、妹みたいで可愛いし、ついいたずらしたくなる
records.en_original: I taught Yuki how to scoop for goldfish. Seeing her so focused on something made me feel like she was my cute little sister, which made me want to mess with her.
records.en: I taught Yuki how to scoop for goldfish. Seeing her so focused on something made me feel like she was my cute little sister, which made me want to mess with her.

records.jp: 勇希とテントでお泊りをした。特別な感じで何だか良^00かったし、普段やらないようなことに興味を持ってやってみるのも、たまにはいいかもしれない
records.en_original: Yuki and I spent the night in the tent. There was something special about it, and it was nice to try something a bit out of the ordinary.
records.en: Yuki and I spent the night in the tent. There was something special about it, and it was nice to try something a bit out of the ordinary.

records.jp: みんなの役に立つものを作りたいという詩さんと一緒に工作をした。みんなのために出来ることを考える詩さんは、とても危険な人には見えない
records.en_original: Uta told me she wanted to make something useful for everyone, so we did some crafting together. She doesn't seem so dangerous to me.
records.en: Uta told me she wanted to make something useful for everyone, so we did some crafting together. She doesn't seem so dangerous to me.

records.jp: 図書室で詩さんにおススメの本を紹介した。普段は漫画や小説を読まないみたいだけど、興味も持ってくれたみたいで良かった！
records.en_original: Went to the library with Uta and gave her some of my recommendations. She said she doesn't usually read manga or novels, but she sounded like she was interested in trying them out!
records.en: Went to the library with Uta and gave her some of my recommendations. She said she doesn't usually read manga or novels, but she sounded like she was interested in trying them out!

records.jp: 中庭で詩さんとマドレーヌを分け合って食べた。一緒に美味しいものを食べる喜びを、詩さんも感じてくれたみたい
records.en_original: Uta and I shared some madeleines in the courtyard. Food always tastes better when eaten with a friend. I think Uta felt it too.
records.en: Uta and I shared some madeleines in the courtyard. Food always tastes better when eaten with a friend. I think Uta felt it too.

records.jp: 屋上で詩さんとのんびり過ごした。寝そべって開放的な気分になると、普段考えつかないような発見があって面白い
records.en_original: Uta and I spent some time relaxing on the rooftop. It was interesting laying under the open sky. Makes you think about stuff you don't usually get a chance to.
records.en: Uta and I spent some time relaxing on the rooftop. It was interesting laying under the open sky. Makes you think about stuff you don't usually get a chance to.

records.jp: 詩さんと現実世界で人があまりいない季節に、一緒に海へ行く約束をした。他にも一緒にやりたいことは沢山あるし、全部叶えてみせる！
records.en_original: I promised Uta we would go to the beach in the real world during the off-season. There are so many other things I want to do together with her. I'll make sure they all happen!
records.en: I promised Uta we would go to the beach in the real world during the off-season. There are so many other things I want to do together with her. I'll make sure they all happen!

records.jp: プールで詩さんと程よく身体を動かした。水着姿の詩さん、いつも以上に白い肌が目立ってて綺麗だったなー
records.en_original: Got some exercise in the pool with Uta. Her skin looked so pretty...
records.en: Got some exercise in the pool with Uta. Her skin looked so pretty...

records.jp: お祈りの意味を考えていた詩さん。確かに方法も祈る内容も人それぞれだけど、願いを叶えたいって思うこと自体に意味があると思うな
records.en_original: Uta was wondering why people bother praying. I think it differs from person to person, but the most important thing is faith that your wish will come true.
records.en: Uta was wondering why people bother praying. I think it differs from person to person, but the most important thing is faith that your wish will come true.

records.jp: 詩さんと好きな音楽の話をした。詩さんの好きな曲も聴いてみたいし、学校にある色んな曲を一緒に探してみよう！
records.en_original: Uta and I talked about our favorite music. I really want to hear the stuff she likes, hopefully we can find some good stuff around the school!
records.en: Uta and I talked about our favorite music. I really want to hear the stuff she likes, hopefully we can find some good stuff around the school!

records.jp: オルガンを弾いていた記憶を思い出した詩さん。本人は謙遜してたけど、とても上手で、綺麗な音だった。私も練習して、いつか一緒に弾いてみたいな
records.en_original: Uta regained her memories of playing the organ. She tried to downplay it, but I think she was amazing. I should practice too so we can play together someday.
records.en: Uta regained her memories of playing the organ. She tried to downplay it, but I think she was amazing. I should practice too so we can play together someday.

records.jp: 詩さんは普段あまりよく寝れていないみたい。嬉しいことに私には気を遣わずに接してくれているみたいだし、私が詩さんを労わってあげよう！
records.en_original: Uta said that she hasn't been sleeping very well lately. I'm glad she feels comfortable talking with me. I'll make sure to take good care of her!
records.en: Uta said that she hasn't been sleeping very well lately. I'm glad she feels comfortable talking with me. I'll make sure to take good care of her!

records.jp: 詩さんともふもふのぬいぐるみに抱き着いて癒された。詩さんがキュートなぬいぐるみに抱き着いている光景は可愛すぎて破壊力抜群だった
records.en_original: That stuffed animal today was adorable. Uta looked so cute hugging it I thought I was gonna explode.
records.en: That stuffed animal today was adorable. Uta looked so cute hugging it I thought I was gonna explode.

records.jp: ロケットの内部に興味深々の詩さん。本物のロケット^00じゃないけど、乗り気で楽しそうな詩さんを見れてよ^00かった
records.en_original: Uta was so curious about the inside of the rocket. Too bad it's not a real rocket, but it was nice seeing her so interested in something.
records.en: Uta was so curious about the inside of the rocket. Too bad it's not a real rocket, but it was nice seeing her so interested in something.

records.jp: 人や生き物と心を通わせるのが苦手なことを気にしている詩さん。でも感受性は人それぞれだし、街燈を好きだと感じる詩さんは素敵だと思う
records.en_original: Uta feels ashamed because she can't communicate with people and animals well. But everyone is different in their own way. Plus, I love how much she likes those street lamps.
records.en: Uta feels ashamed because she can't communicate with people and animals well. But everyone is different in their own way. Plus, I love how much she likes those street lamps.

records.jp: 仲間となら、何をしたって楽しい。この世界にきて私が気づいたこと。一緒にキャンプファイヤーを見つめて、暖かい気持ちを共有できた詩さんにも、きっと伝わったよね
records.en_original: Anything can be fun with good friends. I've learned that since coming to this world. After gazing into the campfire and sharing these warm feelings together, I think Uta felt that as well.
records.en: Anything can be fun with good friends. I've learned that since coming to this world. After gazing into the campfire and sharing these warm feelings together, I think Uta felt that as well.

records.jp: 詩さんと一緒に、のんびりひまわりを眺めながら過ごした。二人で過ごした時間や思い出が増えていくことが嬉しいし、詩さんも同じように思ってくれているみたい
records.en_original: Uta and I spent some time relaxing and enjoying the sunflowers. I had a lot of fun. It sounds like Uta enjoys spending time with me as much as I enjoy spending time with her.
records.en: Uta and I spent some time relaxing and enjoying the sunflowers. I had a lot of fun. It sounds like Uta enjoys spending time with me as much as I enjoy spending time with her.

records.jp: 美弦さんと二人で何か歌って放送で流したかったけど、残念ながら拒否されてしまった。でもいつか必ず……、とりあえず明日もう一回誘ってみようかな……
records.en_original: I really wanted to sing with Mio over the broadcast system, but she said no... One day... Maybe I'll ask her again tomorrow.
records.en: I really wanted to sing with Mio over the broadcast system, but she said no... One day... Maybe I'll ask her again tomorrow.

records.jp: 美弦さんと私は性格も全然違うし、現実世界なら仲良くなっていなかったかもしれない。そう考えると、この世界で出会えたことはちょっとした奇跡だったのかも
records.en_original: Mio and I have completely different personalities. I wonder if we would have gotten along in the other world? Thinking like that, it's kind of amazing we met here.
records.en: Mio and I have completely different personalities. I wonder if we would have gotten along in the other world? Thinking like that, it's kind of amazing we met here.

records.jp: 美弦さんは一人で考え込むことが多いけど、本音や弱音をお互い話して支え合うことが絆だと思う。これからは遠慮なく話してくれると嬉しいな
records.en_original: Mio tends to keep her thoughts to herself, but being able to share your feelings and help each other is what makes a good friendship. One day I hope she doesn't feel like she has to hold back.
records.en: Mio tends to keep her thoughts to herself, but being able to share your feelings and help each other is what makes a good friendship. One day I hope she doesn't feel like she has to hold back.

records.jp: 美弦さんにクッキーの作り方を教えてもらった。綺麗に作れたし、私の作ったクッキーを美弦さんに食べてもらえたし、満足！
records.en_original: Mio taught me how to make cookies. They came out looking really good, and she even seemed to like how they tasted!
records.en: Mio taught me how to make cookies. They came out looking really good, and she even seemed to like how they tasted!

records.jp: 学校の廊下を思い切り走るなんて、この世界でしか出来ないし、やれることは何でも楽しまないとね。美弦さんも満更でもなかったみたいだし、また一緒に自由を楽しもう！
records.en_original: Only in this world can I run through the halls and not get in trouble. It was a blast! I think Mio was having a good time too. I want to enjoy our freedom as much as we can!
records.en: Only in this world can I run through the halls and not get in trouble. It was a blast! I think Mio was having a good time too. I want to enjoy our freedom as much as we can!

records.jp: 美弦さんと花壇に出ていた新しい芽を観察した。美弦さんはお花が好きみたいだし、綺麗なお花が沢山咲く花壇になりますように！
records.en_original: Mio and I made some observations on some new sprouts in the garden. She seems to like flowers a lot. I hope they bloom soon!
records.en: Mio and I made some observations on some new sprouts in the garden. She seems to like flowers a lot. I hope they bloom soon!

records.jp: 真面目な美弦さんは、テキトーな私とは正反対の性格だ。本人は面白みのない性格なんていうけど、私はそんな美弦さんが好きだし憧れている
records.en_original: Mio's so serious, she's like the opposite of me. She says she's boring, but I like her the way she is.
records.en: Mio's so serious, she's like the opposite of me. She says she's boring, but I like her the way she is.

records.jp: ベッドで美弦さんに甘えている内に寝てしまった。め^00ちゃくちゃ幸せだったけど、寝る前にもう少し美弦さんの包容力を堪能したかった……
records.en_original: I fell asleep while Mio spoiled me. It was so nice. I do wish I could have savored it a bit more before falling asleep, though...
records.en: I fell asleep while Mio spoiled me. It was so nice. I do wish I could have savored it a bit more before falling asleep, though...

records.jp: 美弦さんは私が七夕に込めた願いを素敵だと言ってくれたけど、美弦さんの願いに比べるとちっぽけに感じた。私も美弦さんみたいな優しい願いが書ける人になりたいな
records.en_original: I feel like my Tanabata wish was kinda lame compared to Mio's. I wish I could be a person who wishes for the stuff Mio wished for.
records.en: I feel like my Tanabata wish was kinda lame compared to Mio's. I wish I could be a person who wishes for the stuff Mio wished for.

records.jp: 美弦さんは宇宙みたいな未知の領域に興味があるみたい。美弦さんの解説付きの宇宙旅行とか、凄い楽しそう！
records.en_original: Mio is interested in places like space that haven't been explored much. A space tour lead by Mio sounds like it would be amazing!
records.en: Mio is interested in places like space that haven't been explored much. A space tour lead by Mio sounds like it would be amazing!

records.jp: 宇宙服って聞くとロボットアニメとか、空想のイメージが強くなるけど、美弦さんのいう通り今現実で使われているからこその趣もある……気がする
records.en_original: Spacesuits always make me think of anime and giant robots, but Mio reminded me that they're actually something used in real life. Pretty cool...
records.en: Spacesuits always make me think of anime and giant robots, but Mio reminded me that they're actually something used in real life. Pretty cool...

records.jp: 美弦さんでも何かに面倒くさいと思う時があるみたい。家のお手伝い程度でめんどくさがってた私と一緒にするのは失礼だけど、ちょっと親近感を感じた
records.en_original: Even Mio has things that she doesn't feel like doing. Nothing compared to me, obviously, I won't even clean my room, but it was nice to see that side of her.
records.en: Even Mio has things that she doesn't feel like doing. Nothing compared to me, obviously, I won't even clean my room, but it was nice to see that side of her.

records.jp: 美弦さんと100円ライドで馬鹿みたいな遊び方をした。距離を縮めるための作戦だったけど、前より仲良くなれた気がするし、作戦大成功！
records.en_original: Mio and I had a ton of fun on the 100 yen rides. It was part of my plan to get to know her better, and it worked out great!
records.en: Mio and I had a ton of fun on the 100 yen rides. It was part of my plan to get to know her better, and it worked out great!

records.jp: 美弦さんは自分と仲良くなりたがる私に動揺してたけど、好きだし憧れてるから仲良くなりたいだけ！　伝われ！この想い！
records.en_original: Mio got a little fluster when I told her I want to get closer to her. I just think she's so great, I hope we can be even better friends!
records.en: Mio got a little fluster when I told her I want to get closer to her. I just think she's so great, I hope we can be even better friends!

records.jp: 美弦さんと一緒に現実世界の星空を見ると約束した。美弦さんも信じてくれたし、絶対に果たしてみせる！
records.en_original: I promised Mio that we'll go stargazing when we get back to the real world. I have to make sure I keep that promise!
records.en: I promised Mio that we'll go stargazing when we get back to the real world. I have to make sure I keep that promise!

records.jp: きららに私が好きなものを料理してもらったけど、できたものはダークマターだった……。でも私のために料理してくれただけで嬉しい
records.en_original: I asked Kirara to cook my favorite food for me, but she served up something unidentifiable... Oh well, I'm just happy that she cooked for me.
records.en: I asked Kirara to cook my favorite food for me, but she served up something unidentifiable... Oh well, I'm just happy that she cooked for me.

records.jp: 図書室できららとお互いの好きな本を読みあった。私はきららと一緒にいるだけで楽しいし、きららも同じように思ってくれてるみたいで良かった
records.en_original: Kirara and I read each other's favorite books in the library. It was nice just to spend time with her, and I'm glad she seemed to feel the same way.
records.en: Kirara and I read each other's favorite books in the library. It was nice just to spend time with her, and I'm glad she seemed to feel the same way.

records.jp: 初めてラジオに挑戦したきららだけど、正直めちゃく^00ちゃだった。けどそれはそれで、きららならではの^00魅力……なのかな……？
records.en_original: Kirara tried radio broadcasting for the first time and, to be honest, it was a mess. But that's part of Kirara's charm, isn't it...?
records.en: Kirara tried radio broadcasting for the first time and, to be honest, it was a mess. But that's part of Kirara's charm, isn't it...?

records.jp: きららは私たちの冒険が上手く行くか、少し不安に感じているみたい。みんなと一緒ならきっと大丈夫。勇気を持って進んでいこう！
records.en_original: Kirara seems a little anxious about whether our adventures will go well. But as long as we're all together, I'm sure we'll be fine! We just have to be brave and keep moving forward!
records.en: Kirara seems a little anxious about whether our adventures will go well. But as long as we're all together, I'm sure we'll be fine! We just have to be brave and keep moving forward!

records.jp: 一緒に屋上で話してる時、勇希から遊びに誘われたことを伝えると、きららは嫉妬しちゃったみたい。かわい^00かったし、特別に思ってくれているみたいで嬉しいな
records.en_original: Kirara got a little jealous when I mentioned that Yuki asked me to hang out while we were on the roof. It was pretty cute—I'm glad she considers me special to her.
records.en: Kirara got a little jealous when I mentioned that Yuki asked me to hang out while we were on the roof. It was pretty cute—I'm glad she considers me special to her.

records.jp: 短いスカートをはいたきららが見た過ぎて、つい強引な手段に出てしまった……。今回は失敗だったけど、諦めきれないからどこかで再挑戦しよう
records.en_original: I wanted to see Kirara in a short skirt so bad that I resorted to desperate measures... I failed this time, but I mustn't give up. I'll try again another time.
records.en: I wanted to see Kirara in a short skirt so bad that I resorted to desperate measures... I failed this time, but I mustn't give up. I'll try again another time.

records.jp: きららに参拝の作法を教えてもらった。しっかり作法通りにお願いしたし、私ときららの願いが叶うといいな！
records.en_original: Kirara taught me how to pray. I did it just like she said, so I hope our wishes will come true!
records.en: Kirara taught me how to pray. I did it just like she said, so I hope our wishes will come true!

records.jp: カプセルトイで目当てのものを一発で引いたきららに運気の念を送ってもらったけど、結果は撃沈。やっぱりそう甘くはないか……
records.en_original: Kirara got the toy she wanted from the capsule machine on her first try. I asked her to send some of her luck my way, but it didn't work...
records.en: Kirara got the toy she wanted from the capsule machine on her first try. I asked her to send some of her luck my way, but it didn't work...

records.jp: 畳部屋にあったクッキーをきららと食べ終わった後に、勇希のものだったことを思い出した。まあ一緒に謝ってお詫びのお菓子をあげたら許してくれたし問題なし！
records.en_original: After Kirara and I finished eating the cookies in the tatami-floored room, I remembered that they were Yuki's. But we apologized and gave her some candy and she forgave us. No harm no foul!
records.en: After Kirara and I finished eating the cookies in the tatami-floored room, I remembered that they were Yuki's. But we apologized and gave her some candy and she forgave us. No harm no foul!

records.jp: 誰かの手によって生み出されたものにロマンを感じるというきらら。自分でも作っているみたいだけど、一体どんな内容なんだろう……
records.en_original: Kirara says she's interested in any product of human creativity. It sounds like she also does some kind of art on her own, but she wouldn't tell me what...
records.en: Kirara says she's interested in any product of human creativity. It sounds like she also does some kind of art on her own, but she wouldn't tell me what...

records.jp: 私の顔を記憶して、会いたい時に思い出すというきらら。会いたければいつでも会えるし、その度に思い出も増えるから遠慮なく呼んで欲しいな
records.en_original: Kirara says she memorized my face so she can picture it whenever she misses me. But I wish she'd just call me when she wants to see me so we could make more memories together.
records.en: Kirara says she memorized my face so she can picture it whenever she misses me. But I wish she'd just call me when she wants to see me so we could make more memories together.

records.jp: きららと金魚すくいを楽しんだ。お互い一匹ずつしか取れなかったけど、私の元に来たご縁を忘れず大切に育ててあげよう
records.en_original: Kirara and I had fun scooping goldfish. We were only able to get one each, but I'm going to take good care of mine and remember what brought it to me.
records.en: Kirara and I had fun scooping goldfish. We were only able to get one each, but I'm going to take good care of mine and remember what brought it to me.

records.jp: 井戸の近くできららが声がするとか言いだしてびっくりしたけど、きららのお腹が鳴ってるだけだった。ホラーだとお約束の場所だし、本当に何かいるかと思った……
records.en_original: Kirara scared me with her talk of hearing voices near the well. After all the horror stories, I was sure there was something there. Turns out it was just her stomach growling...
records.en: Kirara scared me with her talk of hearing voices near the well. After all the horror stories, I was sure there was something there. Turns out it was just her stomach growling...

records.jp: きららは将来何になりたいか、考えたことがなかったみたい。平凡な私と違って、きららなら沢山の候補があると思うな
records.en_original: It seems Kirara hasn't given much thought to what she wants to be in the future. I'm sure she has lots of options though, unlike a regular person like me.
records.en: It seems Kirara hasn't given much thought to what she wants to be in the future. I'm sure she has lots of options though, unlike a regular person like me.

records.jp: きららは石灯籠の灯を見るのが好きみたい。「火口に腕を入れたら抜けなくなった」なんて経験をしても好きなんだから、きららにとってはよっぽど魅力的なんだろうな
records.en_original: Kirara loves to look at the stone lanterns. She still likes them even after getting her arm stuck in one, so they must have some kind of unique allure for her.
records.en: Kirara loves to look at the stone lanterns. She still likes them even after getting her arm stuck in one, so they must have some kind of unique allure for her.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、こころに話した。選択する道を示してくれるだけで凄いと伝えてくれるこころのお陰で、気持ちが楽になった
records.en_original: I spoke to Kokoro about feeling helpless. She told me she appreciates that I help her understand the paths we can take. It made me feel a lot better.
records.en: I spoke to Kokoro about feeling helpless. She told me she appreciates that I help her understand the paths we can take. It made me feel a lot better.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、詩帆さんに話した。大切なのは自分にできることはやり切ったと思えることだという詩帆さんの言葉で、前向きになれた
records.en_original: I spoke to Shiho about feeling helpless. She told me that the most important thing was being able to feel like I had done all I could. I feel a little better now.
records.en: I spoke to Shiho about feeling helpless. She told me that the most important thing was being able to feel like I had done all I could. I feel a little better now.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、日菜子さんに話した。正解はこれからも分からないかもしれないけど、一緒に進んでいこうと日菜子さんが励ましてくれたお陰で、もう一度前を向く力をもらえた
records.en_original: I spoke to Hinako about feeling helpless. She said we might never know the correct answer, but she'll be with me all the way. It gave me the strength I needed to lift my head up.
records.en: I spoke to Hinako about feeling helpless. She said we might never know the correct answer, but she'll be with me all the way. It gave me the strength I needed to lift my head up.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、伶那さんに話した。踏み出すことが怖いと正直に話してくれた伶那さんが後ろで支えてくれているのを感じて、もう一度前進する勇気を持てた
records.en_original: I spoke to Rena about feeling helpless. She was honest with me about her fear of stepping forward, and feeling her support gave me the courage to move forward myself.
records.en: I spoke to Rena about feeling helpless. She was honest with me about her fear of stepping forward, and feeling her support gave me the courage to move forward myself.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、きららに話した。使命や役割に答えを出すのは難しいから、考え過ぎても仕方がないというきららの考え方を知って、気持ちが楽になった
records.en_original: I spoke to Kirara about feeling helpless. The way she sees it, it's best not to overthink our mission or role in life because they don't always have a simple answer. Seeing it from her perspective made me feel a little better.
records.en: I spoke to Kirara about feeling helpless. The way she sees it, it's best not to overthink our mission or role in life because they don't always have a simple answer. Seeing it from her perspective made me feel a little better.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、陽桜莉さんに話した。人を信じ続ける陽桜莉さんの真っすぐな強さを感じて、私もみんなを信じて頑張ろうと前向きになれた
records.en_original: I spoke to Hiori about feeling helpless. I could feel her unyielding strength that allowed her to keep believing in people, and it helped me believe in everyone and try harder too.
records.en: I spoke to Hiori about feeling helpless. I could feel her unyielding strength that allowed her to keep believing in people, and it helped me believe in everyone and try harder too.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、美弦さんに話した。悩みは一人で抱えず、相談してほしいと提案してくれた美弦さんのお陰で、気持ちが楽になった
records.en_original: I spoke to Mio about feeling helpless. She suggested that I talk to her about my problems more often, rather than keep them to myself. I feel a lot better now.
records.en: I spoke to Mio about feeling helpless. She suggested that I talk to her about my problems more often, rather than keep them to myself. I feel a lot better now.

records.jp: 行き場のない気持ちを、勇希に話した。泣いたりくよくよしてばかりより、ずっと笑顔の方が人生楽しいという勇希の明るい考えに元気をもらった
records.en_original: I spoke to Yuki about feeling helpless. Her happy-go-lucky attitude was just what I needed.
records.en: I spoke to Yuki about feeling helpless. Her happy-go-lucky attitude was just what I needed.

records.jp: いつの間にか手にしていたフラグメント。^00どこかの誰かからの導きが、この世界で生きる私たちの成長を助けてくれる気がする
records.en_original: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't know who it belongs to, but you feel it will help you in your growth here.
records.en: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't know who it belongs to, but you feel it will help you in your growth here.

records.jp: いつの間にか手にしていたフラグメント。^00どこかの誰かからの応援が、この世界で生きる私たちに戦う力を与えてくれる気がする
records.en_original: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't know who it belongs to, but you feel empowered.
records.en: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't know who it belongs to, but you feel empowered.

records.jp: いつの間にか手にしていたフラグメント。^00どこかの誰かからの祈りが、この世界で生きる私たちを危機から守ってくれる気がする
records.en_original: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't know who it belongs to, but it feels like someone is watching over you.
records.en: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't know who it belongs to, but it feels like someone is watching over you.

records.jp: いつの間にか手にしていたフラグメント。^00記憶にない体験が、この世界で生きる私たちに強敵と戦う知恵を与えてくれる気がする
records.en_original: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't remember why, but it feels like it will give you the wisdom to fight against strong enemies.
records.en: A Fragment that appeared as if from nowhere. You don't remember why, but it feels like it will give you the wisdom to fight against strong enemies.

records.jp: 突然現れた島で戦ったモンスターが落としたフラグメント。気付かないうちに私たちを苦しめていた胸のつかえがとれた気がする
records.en_original: A Fragment dropped by a demon we fought on the island that appeared out of nowhere. I feel like it took a load off everyone's chest somehow...
records.en: A Fragment dropped by a demon we fought on the island that appeared out of nowhere. I feel like it took a load off everyone's chest somehow...

records.jp: 影の少女の一人と戦った際に手に入れたフラグメント。熱くなり過ぎず、落ち着いた感情を保てるようになる
records.en_original: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It allows us to stay cool even in tense situations.
records.en: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It allows us to stay cool even in tense situations.

records.jp: 影の少女の一人と戦った際に手に入れたフラグメント。秘めていた自分の欲求に気づけるようになる
records.en_original: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It enables us to recognize our own desires.
records.en: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It enables us to recognize our own desires.

records.jp: 影の少女の一人と戦った際に手に入れたフラグメント。周りに受け入れられたいという想いが強くなる
records.en_original: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It strengthens our desire to be accepted by those around us.
records.en: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It strengthens our desire to be accepted by those around us.

records.jp: 影の少女の一人と戦った際に手に入れたフラグメント。力が抜けてリラックスできるようになる
records.en_original: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It helps us know when to let go and relax.
records.en: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It helps us know when to let go and relax.

records.jp: 影の少女の一人と戦った際に手に入れたフラグメント。様々な場面で「楽しみたい」という想いが強くなる
records.en_original: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It encourages us to have fun in all kinds of different situations.
records.en: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It encourages us to have fun in all kinds of different situations.

records.jp: 影の少女の一人と戦った際に手に入れたフラグメント。重圧に対する反抗心がわいてくる
records.en_original: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It gives us the strength to resist cracking under pressure.
records.en: A Fragment we got from fighting one of the shadow girls. It gives us the strength to resist cracking under pressure.

records.jp: 突然現れた島で戦闘している時、気が付けば手に入れていたフラグメント。力強い輝きが、私たちの想いの強さを示してくれている気がする
records.en_original: A Fragment that we got somehow while fighting on the island that appeared out of nowhere. I get the feeling that the light that shines brightly from it reflects the strength of our emotions.
records.en: A Fragment that we got somehow while fighting on the island that appeared out of nowhere. I get the feeling that the light that shines brightly from it reflects the strength of our emotions.

records.jp: 気球に乗って景色を眺める日菜子さんが絵になり過ぎて八つ当たりをしたら、変顔を撮らせてくれた。私だけが知ってる貴重な一枚、大切に保存しよう
records.en_original: After I took it out on Hinako for looking too picturesque while gazing out from the balloon, she let me take a picture of her making a funny face. It's an important photo that only I know about, so I'm gonna make sure to keep it safe.
records.en: After I took it out on Hinako for looking too picturesque while gazing out from the balloon, she let me take a picture of her making a funny face. It's an important photo that only I know about, so I'm gonna make sure to keep it safe.

records.jp: 二人で眺めていた花火を「すっごいおいしそう」と言い出したこころの近くには、大量の食べ物が置かれていた。恐るべき食欲……
records.en_original: Just as Kokoro had said the fireworks we were watching looked "super delicious," I noticed she had prepared a huge amount of food. Her appetite is fearsome...
